title: Float-Down Option Figures, Builder Extended Rate Lock
content:
The float-down option of the Builder Extended Rate Lock is available on some lock terms and not on others; the term figures below decide its availability, its improvement threshold and its fee.

| Lock term | Float-downs per lock | Minimum drop of the current offered rate below the locked rate (percentage points) | Float-down fee (percent of the loan amount) | Minimum float-down fee (USD) | Float-down changes the lock expiration date |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 60-Day Standard Lock | 0 | 0.250 | 0.250% | 0.00 | No |
| 90-Day Lock | 0 | 0.250 | 0.250% | 0.00 | No |
| 120-Day Extended Lock | 1 | 0.250 | 0.250% | 250.00 | No |
| 180-Day Extended Lock | 1 | 0.250 | 0.250% | 250.00 | No |
| 270-Day Build Lock | 1 | 0.375 | 0.375% | 500.00 | No |
| 360-Day Build Lock | 2 | 0.375 | 0.375% | 500.00 | No |

A figure of 0 float-downs per lock means the float-down is not available on that term.

## Basis questions

**Which terms carry no float-down?** The 60-Day Standard Lock and the 90-Day Lock, each with 0 float-downs per lock.

**Which term allows more than one?** The 360-Day Build Lock, with 2 float-downs per lock; the 120-Day, 180-Day and 270-Day terms allow 1.

**Does any term move the expiration date on a float-down?** No; the last column reads No on all six terms.
